descriptionMarkdown:
Ranger; If you do not move before attacking with a ranger long rifle, your first ranged attack this turn gains +2 to hit.

Ranger; Your attacks with Accurate Aeldari weapons ignore light cover.

Ranger; Your Death from Elsewhere feature recharges when you roll initiative if you have no uses remaining.

Ranger; Your attacks from hiding score a critical hit on 19-20.
